description: Upgrade plan to migrate project to Java 25

tasks.reason: Upgrade to Java 25 to benefit from the latest performance improvements, security patches, and language features available in this LTS release.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade JDK to version 25. Update build configuration (pom.xml or build.gradle) to set Java source and target compatibility to 25. Ensure all dependencies and plugins are compatible with Java 25. Update any deprecated APIs removed in Java 25.
tasks.summary: Upgraded the project from Java 21 to Java 25. Updated pom.xml java.version property to 25, and updated Dockerfile base images to eclipse-temurin:25. Spring Boot 4.0.1 is compatible with Java 25. Build and all unit tests pass.
